The primary material of a candle is typically wax. Common types of wax include paraffin wax (derived from petroleum), beeswax (produced by honey bees), soy wax (made from soybean oil), and palm wax. The wax serves as the fuel source that melts and is drawn up the wick to sustain the flame.
